description: Turn broken or messy JSON text into valid JSON. Strips Markdown code fences and prose before/after the JSON, removes comments and trailing commas, converts single/curly quotes, quotes unquoted keys, maps Python None/True/False, inserts missing commas, closes truncated strings/arrays/objects, and wraps NDJSON / several concatenated objects into one array. Returns the parsed value (json), the repaired text, and the list of fixes applied; valid input passes through unchanged with no fixes. Optional schema (+ coerce) also validates the result. Fails with isError (code unrepairable / no_json_found) when nothing JSON-like can be recovered. Pure computation: read-only, no network access, inputs not stored. Same engine and limits as POST /api/v1/repair.

coerce.description: Convert values toward the schema's declared types before validating: "42" → 42, "true" → true, "null" → null, 5 → "5", x → [x]. Each change is listed in coercions.

draft.description: JSON Schema draft. Default: from the schema's $schema, else 2020-12.

format.description: Layout of the returned text: compact (default), pretty (2-space indent), or preserve (jsonrepair's output, keeps original spacing and long-number digits).

input.description: The raw (possibly broken) JSON text, e.g. an LLM reply with code fences and prose around the JSON. Max 102,400 bytes (UTF-8).

schema.description: A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 by default; 2019-09, 7 and 4 also supported). Only local $refs (#/...) resolve; remote $refs are an error. Max 32 KB.

name: repair_json

changed.description: false when the input was already valid JSON

json.description: The repaired JSON value (coerced if coerce was used)

errorCount.description: Total errors (at most 50 are listed); a lower bound when errorsTruncated is true

path.description: JSON Pointer to the failing value ("" = root)

errorsTruncated.description: true when the validator produced more than 5,000 raw errors and only the first 5,000 were examined

values.description: Number of top-level JSON values found (more than 1 = wrapped in an array)

title: Repair broken JSON (LLM output) and list the fixes
